turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on a, an and the?
turns.tutor:
Let me solve one example first and say what I think.
"I have an egg for lunch." First, I say the next word: egg. Next, I listen to its first sound, "e". That is a vowel sound, so I choose an.
Rule: we use an before a vowel sound and a before other sounds.
Right: My sister has a bike. Wrong: My sister has an bike.

Now it is your turn. Write a or an:
She has ___ orange in her bag. (answer with only the missing word)
